observations: A cylindrical metal popcorn machine with a black perforated band around the middle, mounted on a metal stand.
The top has a domed lid with a pressure valve and a handle with a black grip.
The machine is in a cluttered outdoor or semi-outdoor market setting with terracotta pots, plastic containers, and boxes (including Kenwood and Byson brands) around it.
The machine shows signs of use: scratches, discoloration, and some rust or soot on the black band and base.
No visible brand or model name on the machine itself in any photo.
The seller's text claims it is a 'gas popcorn machine for maximum output'.
